messages:
jia: quick heads-up — started canary for model v2p1-int4 at 12:00 PT on 2% traffic. initial smoke looks fine but rerank MRR on longdocs slice is down ~3.2% absolute vs the fp16 baseline. filing here for triage.
ops-bot: deploy: canary v2p1-int4 -> 2% traffic (region: us-west2). canary_id=canary-5188889999 :rocket:

mike: thanks — do we have split by cohort? longdocs only or global?
sarah: looking now. early breakdown: short Qs stable, longdocs (len>2k tokens) drove most of the delta. latency unchanged. hallucination proxies (fact-check reranker mismatch) up slightly.
jia: exact numbers from eval harness: longdocs MRR_fp16=0.482, MRR_int4=0.450 -> abs -0.032 (rel ~-6.6%). overall traffic MRR -0.8% abs. sample sizes decent for canary window.
evan: that's above our auto-rollback threshold (we've set abs-MRR-drop>0.015 sustained 10m to trigger). but ops auto-rollback hasn't fired yet. maybe metric smoothing is masking it.
mike: what does the rollout policy JSON look like? can we tune sensitivity for this canary?
jia: current rollout policy: 
```json
{"canary_percent":2, "metric":"mrr_rerank_longdocs", "rollback_abs_threshold":0.015, "window_seconds":600, "stabilization_minutes":15}
```
sarah: we may want composite gating: require both mrr_rerank_longdocs and hallucination_delta < 0.01. int4 seems to trade some fidelity for perf.
evan: immediate options: 1) rollback to v2p1-fp16 for this route 2) restrict int4 to short contexts only 3) pause promotion and run targeted synthetic eval across longdoc slices + reranker shadowing.
mike: I vote rollback for user-facing safety, run heavier shadow tests. can we do a fast rollback command?
ops-bot: suggest: `infractl rollout rollback --canary=canary-5188889999 --target-model=v2p1-fp16 --reason="canary-mrr-drop"`
jia: attempting manual pin now for route /v1/generate that saw the drop. executing: `infractl route pin --route=/v1/generate --model=v2p1-fp16`
sarah: confirmed pinned, traffic now serving fp16 for that route. canary still running on other routes at 2%.
evan: good. next: reproduce locally with a seeded longdoc eval and run NVProf traces to check where quantized path differs. I'll spin up a focused job: `jobs/run_eval --model v2p1-int4 --slice longdocs --seed 42`
mike: also check KV-cache warming behavior: int4 path might have different cache hit patterns for very long contexts. add `kv_warmup=true` to the eval.
jia: creating follow-up ticket with repro artifacts and suggested gating update: bump rollback_abs_threshold to 0.02 for longdocs and add hallucination_delta composite metric. tagging @mike @sarah @evan.
sarah: can we also add a temporary route-policy that funnels 0% production traffic for int4 on longdocs until we validate? i.e. route filter by seqlen > 2048 -> always fp16.
evan: yes, add route policy in the next config push. I'll draft the policy.
mike: postmortem checklist items: collect sample diffs (pairs), reranker scores, KV cache hit rates, token-level logits for a subset. prioritize longdoc regression causes.
sarah: thanks everyone. ongoing: evan will run focused evals, mike will own triage artifacts, jia will monitor canary and update rollout policy. ping here with results. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-tracker: create incident INC-5188890001 -> "canary v2p1-int4 longdoc MRR regression" assigned: eng-ml oncall
jia: closing loop: route pinned and triage running. will post follow-ups in this thread with eval results.
